# CoAuth

> Agent-native prior-authorization cockpit. A clinician and an AI agent complete
> a health-insurance prior authorization together on one live page using the
> WebMCP standard. The agent fills and checks the payer form via typed tools; the
> human keeps clinical judgment and the legally required signature.

CoAuth exposes 13 WebMCP tools. The agent can load the patient record, read payer
rules, fill non-judgment fields, attach evidence, assess denial risk, detect
clinical conflicts, and draft narrative text and appeal letters. The agent cannot
fabricate clinician-judgment fields or submit. `fill_field` and
`attach_evidence` refuse clinician-judgment fields outright, and `submit`
requires an approval minted only for an authenticated clinician session. No
WebMCP tool on this page authenticates, so an agent working the form has no
route to one. (The demo credential is published in the project README, so a
caller that reads it can authenticate directly against the API. That is a
property of the demo, not of the design.)

## When to use

Reach for CoAuth when a user needs to prepare, check, or submit a health-insurance
**prior authorization** - especially for a specialty/biologic drug - and wants an
agent to do the form-filling and rule-checking while a clinician keeps final say.
Good jobs: "start a prior auth for <patient> <drug> with <payer>", "check this PA
for denial risk", "what's missing before we submit", "draft the medical-necessity
statement", "draft an appeal for this denial". Do not use it to submit without a
clinician: `submit` is blocked until a human signs, and the signature is bound
to an authenticated clinician identity rather than to a name in a request.

## Tools

- get_workflow_guidance: recommended sequence + safety rules (read)
- get_submission_state: read the whole current submission, provenance and gate status (read)
- load_patient_context: load a structured patient record (read)
- check_payer_rules: fetch a payer's required fields and policy (read)
- fill_field: set one typed form field (write)
- attach_evidence: link a clinical document to a field (write)
- validate_submission: per-field pass/fail incl. format checks (read)
- assess_denial_risk: score denial probability and drivers (read)
- detect_conflicts: surface contraindications / unmet step therapy (read)
- draft_field: propose clinician-judgment text, suggestion only (read)
- draft_appeal: draft an appeal letter from the record and payer policy (read)
- flag_for_human: mark a field as needing clinician input (write)
- submit: submit the prior authorization - blocked until an authenticated
  clinician signs; the server re-checks the clinical rules before accepting
